Lfm3ForCausalLM.js: a WebGPU inference runtime for Liquid AI's LFM3 text models (GGUF).

Source: https://huggingface.co/spaces/webml-community/LFM3-1.7B-WebGPU-Pi (dist/runtime/Lfm3ForCausalLM.js)
License of the Space: Apache-2.0. The library includes Hugging Face tokenization and Jinja templating.

Model: LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B-GGUF. The weights are not bundled: they download on first use from
Hugging Face and remain subject to their repository's terms (the LFM Open License).

Used by SeloAI's in-app agent, Pi (src/agent/).
